event_entry_type.description: The entry type that holds your events. Marvin has no built-in event type.

event_date.description: The date to count down to: one of the entry type's date fields, or a date every entry has (its scheduled publish or expiry date).

remind_at.description: The time of day the reminders are drafted, in your workspace's time zone, for example `09:00`.

draft_entry_type.description: The entry type the reminders are drafted as.

draft_body_field.description: The text field of that type.
